title: Technology Sector Update for 10/22/2018: YNDX, EBIX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.66%
AAPL: +0.69%
IBM: +0.27%
CSCO: +0.35%
GOOG: +0.78%
Technology stocks were inching higher in pre-market trading Monday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Yandex N.V ( YNDX ), which was up more than 7% as it said the board's review of strategic alternatives may or may not lead to any proposal to change its capital structure or to any potential transaction.
In other sector news:
(=) Ebix ( EBIX ) was unchanged after its EbixCash, the company's Financial Exchange Division, unveiled initiatives as a part of its plans to expand its Via Travel business.
